Elena Ortiz: Starting Cedar Health onboarding prep. Quick internal roll call before inviting customer. Can we meet 11:00am PT tomorrow for a 25min dry-run?
Samir Gupta: 11am works. I'll cover authentication, secrets, and any KMS notes.
Carly Nguyen: I'll do success metrics and post-demo survey design. Tentative 30-day KPIs: staging calls authenticated; 4 validated prompts with quality pass; dashboard & alerting live.
Elena Ortiz: Stakeholders to include in customer invite: Rajesh (PM), Priya (Data Lead), Marcus (Security). Internal leads: Elena (CS), Samir (Platform SE), Carly (CS Ops).
Samir Gupta: Tech timeline proposal: Day 0-2 creds & network; Day 3-8 integration + schema mapping; Day 9-16 validation & perf tuning; Day 17-30 pilot + rollout prep. If they want VPC, add security window +5 business days.
Carly Nguyen: Renewal watch: flag if no pilot traffic by day 30 or if security blocks data path. I'll add a "renewal risk" column on the 30-day board.
Elena Ortiz: Quick risk mitigation: schedule security pre-check on Day 1, and request expected QPS and embedding volumes from customer in advance.
DevOpsBot: Created event "Cedar Health — Internal Onboard Dry Run" on 2026-04-05 11:00 PT. Guests: Elena Ortiz, Samir Gupta, Carly Nguyen.
Samir Gupta: Action items: Samir — network/KMS notes + perf checklist; Carly — healthboard + survey; Elena — customer invite + agenda; all — add 4 example prompts to the shared docs before the dry run.
Carly Nguyen: I'll push the draft healthboard to #cs-tools by COB today and include a simple 3-question feedback survey.
Elena Ortiz: Good. I'll run the dry run 15 minutes ahead and then invite Rajesh/Priya/Marcus after prep. Closing thread; will post customer invite once ready. :white_check_mark:
